reason: The hypothesis combines the subtraction-method insight from P1/P6 (Mo reduces ductility) with the electronegativity-difference concept from P41 to propose a specific partial Mo-to-Nb substitution in NbZrTiHfMo. However, P7 and P11 already report a ZrTiHfNb0.5Mo0.5 alloy with high plasticity (>50% compressive strain) and good strength, which is essentially the same intervention and predicted outcome. The hypothesis therefore restates a known result as a prediction, making it largely copied.
